subject: [PATCH v2 03/12] mm/khugepaged: rename mthp_present_ptes bitmap to eligible_ptes

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch renames the bitmap 'mthp_present_ptes' to 'eligible_ptes' in the mm/khugepaged module. The name change reflects that a set bit in this bitmap indicates not only that a PTE is present, but also that it has passed additional checks such as uffd, lazyfree, anonymity, and sharing. The patch updates comments and code accordingly without introducing any functional changes.
